title: A finding. Its evidence. Your next move.
premise: Make the finished reliability report NUMEK’s most recognizable object. A large, readable report page sits beside a confident statement; precise annotations carry the identity into the software.
type: Candidate: Literata for statements and report titles; Hanken Grotesk for UI and numerical text. The studies use local serif/sans substitutes; final font proportions remain to be refined.
landing: Open on one actual finding and its report. Scroll into the supporting distribution, then the range of task families, explainable methods, local execution and the HTML/PDF/JSON handoff.
home: A horizontal application bar above a report library. Typographic rows and document previews organize a local-session collection; no fictional hosted history or team activity.
results: An open report with a floating outline, a broad reading column and aligned evidence notes. Explanations lead; distributions, exact references and limitations stay one step away.
motion: A report excerpt enlarges into its evidence section without losing its location. Annotation reveals follow user selection. No page flipping or simulated paper physics.
strength: Best bridge between technical investigation and a report a stakeholder can read.
risk: Could become overly literary. Keep the document genuinely readable and give dense technical tables enough width.
signature: Offset report composition; mulberry annotation marks; measured serif scale.

title: Look closer.
premise: Begin with the real material: rows, columns and a relationship that needs investigation. Large compressed typography gives the company conviction; a highly legible workbook gives the product precision.
type: Candidate: Barlow Condensed at display scale; Barlow for application text. Tabular numerals, medium labels and restrained weight changes support dense inspection.
landing: A magnified excerpt of Bike Sharing occupies most of the first view. Focus on a column, expose its relationship, then show distributions, task-specific investigations, methods and local reports.
home: A narrow tool rail, dataset tabs and a full-width workbook. Findings are a real alternate view, not a grid of summary cards. The selected population remains visible.
results: A field inspector opens alongside the table. Values, declarations and the exact supporting finding are adjacent; users can retain their place while reading context.
motion: A selected column gains width while surrounding columns settle into place. Field-to-inspector transitions preserve alignment; hover remains quiet. Marketing focus effects reduce to immediate states in the app.
strength: Most direct environment for an ML engineer investigating concrete input problems.
risk: A workbook could underrepresent text, images and native documents. Their evidence needs appropriate previews inside the same inspection grammar.
signature: Compressed display type; full-bleed tables; mint field selection; unusually narrow navigation.

title: Every finding has a source.
premise: Give the connection between observation, finding and source a visible form. Only actual declared or computed relationships are drawn; choosing one exposes the associated evidence.
type: Candidate: IBM Plex Sans for brand and UI; IBM Plex Mono only for exact field names, source locators and expressions. Human explanations stay in proportional type.
landing: Open with one traceable path from supplied columns to an observed identity and a contextual action. Continue into row evidence, native-document mappings, bounded investigations, methods and local privacy.
home: Three coordinated columns: sources, findings and evidence preview. A dark source region anchors the identity while the analytical reading surface stays light.
results: Selected finding at left, bounded exact row or document evidence in the middle, interpretation and coverage at right. Relationships show provenance and declared context, not external truth.
motion: Selecting a finding highlights just its route and resolves the corresponding source preview. Marketing can draw the path once; the app uses short panel transitions. No drifting network or 3D scene.
strength: Most distinctive expression of DataTrust’s traceability and connected-evidence depth.
risk: Three columns can overwhelm smaller screens. Collapse them into a source → finding → evidence stack with persistent context and accessible back navigation.
signature: Bracketed source references; lilac relationship surfaces; coordinated vertical panes.

title: What is your data telling you?
premise: Let a meaningful analytical picture do the introduction. Start with a real distribution, explain one finding in a short visual sequence, then open the evidence for deeper inspection.
type: Candidate: Syne for expressive, broad statements; Source Sans 3 for explanations and UI. Chart labels use a deliberately calmer scale than the public headline.
landing: A large target distribution opens the page. Population, shape, selected relationship and contextual interpretation appear in sequence. Follow with task-family examples, methods, local execution and the full report.
home: An attention ribbon selects among real findings above one large analytical canvas. The right reading area and a bottom evidence tray replace a conventional sidebar and card grid.
results: An explanation connects actual sample values, then states the full support and caveats. Technical details remain available in a conventional table; the picture never substitutes for exact counts.
motion: Scroll introduces the population, then isolates the relevant observation while retaining a fixed chart frame. In the app, the same sequence is controlled by explicit steps with a reduced-motion static view.
strength: Strongest for understanding unfamiliar diagnostics and presenting them to mixed technical audiences.
risk: Choreography can slow experienced users. Provide direct access to findings, rows and full methods; avoid mandatory animation.
signature: Large open charts; lemon surfaces; blue explanatory shapes; question-led hierarchy.

title: Put the evidence side by side.
short: Difference gives the page its structure
premise: Use paired space to make analytical differences tangible. NUMEK’s identity comes from equal visual weight, aligned evidence and clear separation between source facts and interpretation.
type: Candidate: Archivo Black for compact, emphatic public statements; Archivo for the application. The paired panes share aligned type scales and tabular numerals.
landing: Two existing reports introduce the same dataset with different input sets. Continue through actual comparative effects and support, the broader DataTrust family, transparent methods and local report artifacts.
home: A compact top navigation and an analysis list with a bottom comparison selection tray. Single analyses remain first-class; comparisons have a dedicated reading surface.
results: Aligned panes with common chart scales and explicit populations. This sketch pairs existing regression fixtures; any subsequent M4 comparison preview will use a stored M4 fixture and its own computed effects.
motion: Two panes enter in one deliberate composition; a divider establishes alignment. Selecting a field updates both views together. Mobile stacks reference and current with explicit labels and shared scales.
strength: Strongest expression of comparative analysis and a clear way to discuss changing dataset evidence.
risk: Could make comparison seem like the entire product. The full landing page and single-analysis result must show equal analytical depth.
signature: Equal opposing surfaces; blue/apricot pairing; strong horizontal alignment; comparison tray.
